grants.description: Employee provides identity documents for verification
grants.purpose: To verify the identity of the employee before conducting the criminal record check

grants.description: Consent to disclose criminal record information to employer
grants.purpose: To allow the employer to assess suitability for the role based on criminal record

grants.description: Consent to disclose local police information (enhanced checks only)
grants.purpose: To provide additional information held by local police that may be relevant to the role

grants.description: Consent to check barred lists (enhanced with barred lists only)
grants.purpose: To confirm whether the employee is barred from working with children or vulnerable adults

grants.description: Verify employer's eligibility to request DBS checks
grants.purpose: To confirm the employer is authorized to request DBS checks

revocation.mechanism: Contact DBS customer services or withdraw consent through the application before certificate is issued
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled and any fees already paid will not be refunded. The employer will be notified of withdrawal.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide employee identity documents on employee's behalf. Agent cannot make payment without explicit employer authorization. Agent cannot grant consent on behalf of employee - employee must explicitly consent to criminal record disclosure. Agent cannot verify or assess the final certificate - employer must physically review the certificate sent to employee.
